events.text: U-96 left for her sixth patrol in the North Atlantic.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 2 August 1937 , U-96 left for her sixth patrol in the North Atlantic .

events.text: The U-boat was part of group Greenland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 August , the U-boat was part of group Greenland .

events.subject: self
events.quote: on 28 August , she joined group Prince-Elector .

events.subject: self
events.quote: In early September , U-96 belonged to group Seawolf before returning to base .

events.text: She entered St.Nazaire after 42 days at sea.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 September she entered St.Nazaire after 42 days at sea , without attacking any ships .

events.text: U-96 left for her seventh patrol with journalist Lothar-Günther Buchheim aboard.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 27 October , U-96 left for her seventh patrol with journalist Lothar-Günther Buchheim aboard

events.subject: self
events.quote: and joined group Stoßtrupp three days later .

events.text: The group made contact with convoy OS 10.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: The next day , 31 October , the group made contact with convoy OS 10 .

events.text: U-96 was resupplied by the interned German in Vigo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: being resupplied by the interned German on 27 November .

events.text: The U-boat was spotted by a Fairey Swordfish and heavily damaged by two bombs.
events.subject: self
events.quote: late on 30 November the U-boat was spotted by a Fairey Swordfish from No . 812 Squadron FAA and heavily damaged by two bombs

events.text: U-96 returned to Saint Nazaire after 41 days at sea.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6 December 1941 , after 41 days at sea , U-96 returned to Saint Nazaire

events.text: She sank Lake Osweya near Halifax.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She sank Lake Osweya near Halifax on 20 February 1942 .

events.text: She sank Torungen off Nova Scotia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She sank Torungen off Nova Scotia on 22 February

events.text: She attacked Kars later the same day.
events.subject: self
events.quote: and attacked Kars later the same day .

events.text: She sank Tyr about from Halifax.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The submarines final victory this time out came on 9 March when she sank Tyr about from Halifax .

events.text: U-96 left St. Nazaire for the ninth patrol.
events.subject: self
events.quote: U-96 left St . Nazaire on 23 April 1942

events.text: U-96 returned 73 days later without attacking anything.
events.subject: self
events.quote: and returned 73 days later , on 1 July without attacking anything .
